questions.stem: A student mixes two chemicals in a beaker and the temperature drops from 25°C to 18°C. What type of reaction has occurred?

options.text: Exothermic, because energy was released to the surroundings
Endothermic, because the reaction produced heat
Endothermic, because energy was absorbed from the surroundings

questions.explanation: A temperature decrease indicates an endothermic reaction. The reaction absorbs energy from the surroundings (the solution), causing the temperature to drop.
